title: Return to November 5 for documentary filming
place_text: Orman Road near November 5 site, New Underwood, South Dakota

tellings.quote: of that vehicle and walked toward that site man that feeling came over me I about went to my knees

plain: Going back to the place he calls November 5, a site near Orman Road outside New Underwood, South Dakota, tied to the abduction he says he went through, a man was overcome by a feeling so strong he nearly fell to his knees. That man, a former nuclear weapons guard named Mario Woods, tells Michels it happened when he returned in the 2020s for filming, got out of the vehicle and walked toward the site. To him it suggests the place still holds something of what he says happened there.
